userGoal: Show the owner-provided no-repair-2 icon beside a jammed droid's HP for exactly the jammer-status lifetime.
inScope: Validated RGBA PNG import into the existing UI Resources family.
BattleUnitView creates one world-space sprite child, positions it beside HP, and toggles it.
outOfScope: Changes to jammer timing or damage
completionCriteria: The UI resource exists with real transparent pixels.
The view's public method visibly enables and disables the status icon.
The controller applies the state query during normal presentation refresh.
